messages:
maya: Heads-up — starting an ownershare / entropy-heatmap pass tomorrow. Goal: reduce admin-role entropy and attach clear owners. Need to confirm audit logs capture KMS-binding changes. cc @samir
samir: @maya which clusters/environments are in-scope? want a tight scope for the first run. also fyi KMS grant events are in cloud audit logs but we saw a lag last week
devon: saw ~6–12m ingestion lag in prod-audit pipeline Fri 18th — kafka consumer backpressure. we fixed the consumer but that explains gaps
katie: are we doing a full recert or a sampling canary? i'd prefer sampling first. also include batch-job service accounts in the sample
maya: sampling. plan: run ownershare-heatmap -> flag roles with ownerless >72h -> targeted owner outreach -> open remediation tasks. timeline: sample Wed 09:00, remediation Thurs
samir: for KMS specifically: detect grants where principal isn't mapped in the owner DB, tag role as `kms-untethered`. optionally auto-attach a `needs-owner` label so repo tools catch it
devon: quick SQL to find ownerless roles (will tweak for each datastore):
```
SELECT role, count(principal) as principal_count, owner
FROM rbac.roles
WHERE owner IS NULL OR owner = ''
GROUP BY role
HAVING principal_count > 0;
```
maya: nice. also need to ensure auditbot surfaces KMS key_acl change events in the ownershare dashboard. @auditbot can you confirm retention + current ingest latency?
auditbot: auditbot: ingest_latency=8m; retention=400d for key_admin_events. no alerts in last 72h. dashboard: https://internal/audit/kms
katie: we found weird cross-realm grants from CI runners in staging — could be templating issue. devon can you add a quick filter to catch `ci-runner-*` principals?
devon: yep, add `WHERE principal LIKE 'ci-runner-%'` to the query and we'll emit a CSV. then schedule a job to migrate those to `ci-service-account@redwood`
maya: good call. final Q: do we need a temporary allowlist to avoid noisy owner pings during rollout? propose policy `ownershare-allowlist` TTL=24–48h for known infra migrations
samir: +1. i'll add a canary job that emails owners for the top 100 roles by entropy. will include the allowlist flag so we can silence expected churn
katie: small ask — please update the oncall runbook with rollback steps. e.g. to revert an ownershare label: 
```
kubectl annotate rbac role/<role> ownershare- --namespace=infra || true
```
devon: we'll run a dry-run first and post the CSVs here tomorrow morning. will also include a list of CI/cron principals. :eyes:
maya: thanks. i'll open the tasks and link the playbook: https://go/ownershare-playbook. ping @oncall if the canary trips
oncall: oncall: noted. pager policy set: trigger if error_rate>5% OR auditbot.ingest_latency>30m. will escalate to eng-sre then eng-security
maya: perfect — i'll post results after the sample run.
